params.name: workspace_id
params.description: UUID of the workspace; visible in the workspace URL.

params.name: start_ts
params.description: Filter by the data range when the incident was active, this is the start of the range

params.name: end_ts
params.description: Filter by the data range when the incident was active, this is the end of the range

params.name: start_updated_ts
params.description: Filter by the data range when the incident was last updated, this is the start of the range

params.name: end_updated_ts
params.description: Filter by the data range when the incident was last updated, this is the end of the range

params.name: status_list
params.description: Filter by status of incident. Available options: UNVIEWED:1 VIEWED:2 REJECTED:3 SUBMITTED:4 CLOSED:5

params.name: data_only
params.description: If set, response does not contain metadata.

params.name: with_ref
params.description: If set, response contains monitor information or source/table/column information

params.name: include_preview
params.description: If set, incidents of monitor preview are also returned.

params.name: metric_uuids
params.description: Filter by Metric UUIDs

params.name: monitor_uuids
params.description: Filter by Monitor UUIDs

params.name: source_uuids
params.description: Filter by Source UUIDs

params.name: table_uuids
params.description: Filter by Table UUIDs

params.name: names
params.description: Filter by Monitor names
